# Southeastern Logistics

> Family-owned container drayage and freight company based in Miami, Florida. Dry and refrigerated container drayage from ports across Florida and from Savannah, Georgia to destinations nationwide. Over 20 years of experience, with a focus on the seafood importer market. 24/7 dispatch.

## What we do
- Dry and refrigerated (reefer) container drayage from Florida ports and Savannah, GA
- Nationwide freight delivery from port and warehouse origins
- Overweight container hauling (tri-axle chassis) and hazmat transport
- Container and cold storage options through partner facilities near ports

## Where we work
Based in Miami, FL. Pickups at ports across Florida and in Savannah, GA. Deliveries nationwide.

## Credentials
- USDOT 3444873
- MC-1119820
- Hazmat certified
- Overweight certified
